req.title: Basic-auth rejects missing header
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent from a request to /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint should return a 401 status code when the Authorization header is missing. This behavior needs to be verified through a series of tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The positive case will ensure that the endpoint works correctly when the Authorization header is present. The negative case will verify that the endpoint returns a 401 status code when the header is missing. The boundary case will test the behavior when the Authorization header is present but incorrect.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_with_correct_header
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd with correct Authorization header.
expected: HTTP 200 response with authenticated user information.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd2Q='})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': 'user'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_missing_header
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd without Authorization header.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd')
assert response.status_code == 401
assert 'WWW-Authenticate' in response.headers
assert response.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] == 'Basic realm="Fake Realm"'

tests.name: test_basic_auth_with_incorrect_header
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user/passwd with incorrect Authorization header.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd', headers={'Authorization': 'Basic aW52YWxpZDppbnZhbGlk'})
assert response.status_code == 401
assert 'WWW-Authenticate' in response.headers
assert response.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] == 'Basic realm="Fake Realm"'
